Smile lines (also called [nasolabial folds](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/23027-nasolabial-folds) ) are the `natural creases that run from the sides of the nose down to the corners of the mouth`.[[1]](https://www.magnoliaplasticsurgery.org/post/best-treatments-for-smile-lines-that-work)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Pie0-AjAmWc)

### What Causes Smile Lines

- **Natural aging:** Loss of collagen and elastin makes skin thinner and less firm over time.[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/23027-nasolabial-folds)[[2]](https://cascadeeyeskin.com/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-smile-lines/)
- **Volume loss:** Decreased fat, bone density, and support in the midface and cheeks cause skin to sag downward.[[1]](https://cascadeeyeskin.com/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-smile-lines/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Pie0-AjAmWc)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3WGoMQ7QsV4&t=65)
- **Facial movements:** Repeated expressions like smiling and laughing etch dynamic creases into the skin.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3WGoMQ7QsV4&t=65)
- **Lifestyle factors:** Sun exposure, smoking, dehydration, and side-sleeping accelerate skin breakdown.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3WGoMQ7QsV4&t=65)

### Types of Smile Lines

- **Dynamic lines:** Creases that appear only when you smile, laugh, or talk.
- **Static lines:** Permanent folds that remain visible even when your face is completely at rest.[[1]](https://www.laseraway.com/faqs/skin-rejuvenation/how-can-i-get-rid-of-laugh-smile-lines/)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/23027-nasolabial-folds)[[3]](https://cascadeeyeskin.com/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-smile-lines/)

### Treatment Options

- **Skincare & At-Home Care:** Over-the-counter or prescription retinoids (like retinol or tretinoin), vitamin C, peptides, and daily sunscreen help support collagen and prevent deeper lines.[[1]](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/319341)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/DrDorisDay/videos/struggling-with-smile-lines-youre-not-aloneas-we-age-changes-in-the-structure-of/982643737771784/)
- **Dermal Fillers:** Hyaluronic acid or other injectable fillers restore lost volume in the cheeks or directly soften moderate-to-deep folds.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/DrDorisDay/videos/struggling-with-smile-lines-youre-not-aloneas-we-age-changes-in-the-structure-of/982643737771784/)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)[[3]](https://www.magnoliaplasticsurgery.org/post/best-treatments-for-smile-lines-that-work)
- **Neuromodulators (Botox / Dysport):** Used selectively for dynamic movement around the eyes or specific expression areas, though less commonly injected directly into the primary mouth-smile line muscles due to functional risks.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)[[2]](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/319341)[[3]](https://www.laseraway.com/faqs/skin-rejuvenation/how-can-i-get-rid-of-laugh-smile-lines/)
- **In-Office Procedures:** Laser skin resurfacing, microneedling (or RF microneedling), Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP/PRF), chemical peels, or surgical facelifts for advanced laxity.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DDpMFPXxSPp/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/smile-lines)[[3]](https://www.laseraway.com/faqs/skin-rejuvenation/how-can-i-get-rid-of-laugh-smile-lines/)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/DrDorisDay/videos/struggling-with-smile-lines-youre-not-aloneas-we-age-changes-in-the-structure-of/982643737771784/)
